authorization.title: Authorize the Hoben connection
authorization.description: The Hoben service requested client authorization. Enter the authorization code to try again. The code is never stored.

data_description.authorization_code: Enter the numeric authorization code. This value is sensitive.

reauth_confirm.title: Retry the Hoben connection
reauth_confirm.description: The Hoben connection needs validation again. Confirm to retry using the identity already stored. If the Hoben service requests authorization, you will be asked for a code. To use a different HOBEN identifier, configure a new entry.

user.title: Connect your Hoben stove
user.description: This unofficial integration reads V4 stove values every 60 seconds. All entities are read-only.

data_description.user_guid: Enter the HOBEN identifier shown or configured in MyHOBEN, with or without dashes. This value is sensitive.

error.invalid_identifier: The HOBEN identifier is invalid or was rejected by the server.
error.authorization_required: The Hoben service requires client authorization. Submit an authorization code to try again.
error.invalid_authorization_code: The authorization code is not valid. Enter the requested numeric code.
error.stove_connection_required: The stove must be connected to the Hoben service to authorize this client. You can retry later.
error.authorization_rejected: The Hoben service rejected authorization. You can submit a new code to try again.
error.authorization_timeout: The Hoben service reported that authorization timed out. You can submit a new code to try again.
error.server_maintenance: The Hoben service is under maintenance. Please try again later.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Hoben service. Please try again later.
error.unsupported_stove: This stove’s protocol profile is not supported. Only V4 is available.
error.protocol_error: The Hoben response could not be accepted safely. Please try again later.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the sanitized error context in the logs.

abort.already_configured: This Hoben stove is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The Hoben connection was validated and the integration reloaded.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The stored identity does not match this Hoben entry. Configure a new entry to use a different identifier.
